title: Resolution granting a tax break for Bronx affordable housing
summary: This resolution approves a real property tax exemption for a housing project at four Bronx properties (MHANY Cluster 2 rehabilitation), owned by a housing development fund company under Article XI of state law. The exemption runs for up to seven years from February 4, 2020, and can end early if the property stops meeting affordability and ownership rules set by the city housing department.
